title: Concurrency and Shared State
introduction: Concurrent tasks can make progress during overlapping periods, creating new ordering and state risks.
learningOutcomes: Reduce shared mutable state using ownership or messages.

activities.question: What is a race condition?
options: Behaviour that incorrectly depends on timing or interleaving
activities.explanation: A race occurs when unsynchronised operations produce timing-dependent results.

activities.question: Concurrent tasks must always execute simultaneously on different processors.
activities.explanation: Concurrency concerns overlapping progress; parallelism is simultaneous execution.

activities.question: A mutual-exclusion mechanism protecting a critical section is commonly called a ___.
activities.explanation: A lock or mutex allows only one owner into a protected critical section at a time.
